summary: Forced-hover bg comparison shows the market-detail Recent activity header is now edge-to-edge instead of inset.

before_after_pairs.label: Market detail — Recent activity header hover bg (inset → edge-to-edge)
before_after_pairs.note: Hover bg simulated via inline rgba(255,255,255,0.15). Before: stripe inset by parent paddingLeft/Right={4} with inline paddingLeft:0 override. After: stripe spans the section edge-to-edge; text/icon are inset 16px via px-4 on the ButtonBase itself, matching the perps tab pattern.

standalone.label: Perps tab — Recent activity header hover bg (unchanged horizontal, normalized vertical padding)
standalone.note: Perps tab header was already edge-to-edge; the fix normalizes vertical padding (pt-4 mb-2 → py-3) to match the Explore markets sibling.

videos.note: Video recording not captured; static before/after screenshots are sufficient for this visual fix.
